name: Turkmenistan

fees.name: Single-entry visa, 10-day validity (normal processing)
fees.notes: Embassy sticker visa priced by validity/entry type rather than by 'tourist' category; requires a Letter of Invitation from a registered Turkmen travel agency. Same schedule published on US embassy site (usa.tmembassy.gov.tm). Longer validities and multiple-entry cost more (up to $385 single-entry / $515 multiple-entry for 12 months); expedited (1-3 day) processing costs an additional 100% surcharge. Children 7-16 pay 50%, under 7 free.

fees.name: Single-entry visa, 1-year validity (normal processing)
fees.notes: Top end of single-entry fee range; see full table on source for all validity tiers (10 days to 12 months).

fees.name: Transit visa, up to 5 days, one-time (normal processing)
E-visa (planned, not yet operational)
fees.notes: Turkmenistan's April 2025 visa-reform law authorizes creation of an e-visa system, but as of mid-2026 the platform (evisa.gov.tm or similar) has not launched and no Presidential decree setting e-visa fees, categories, or validity has been published. Do not treat as available; amount left null pending official launch.

free_visa_notes: No researched official source indicates any nationality travels visa-free to Turkmenistan; all foreign visitors require a visa (sticker visa via embassy, requiring a Letter of Invitation from a registered local travel agency) or, in future, an e-visa once the pending system launches. No nationality-differentiated (reciprocity) fee schedule was found on official Turkmen embassy pages checked (US, India) - both list the identical validity-based fee table, suggesting fees are uniform across nationalities rather than reciprocity-based. This could not be independently confirmed for all key nationalities (GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) via official sources within this research pass.
